summer_disconnect: Summer disconnection moratorium, Jun 1 - Oct 15 (current cycle 2026); utilities may instead choose a temperature-based rule barring shutoff when 95°F+ or below 32°F is forecast (Arizona Corporation Commission).

CPUC bars electric disconnection for nonpayment when the CalHeatScore heat-index forecast crosses a set threshold (lowered in 2026 from 100°F to 90°F-equivalent), with utilities required to consult the index before any shutoff (California PUC).

winter_disconnect: Winter moratorium, Nov 1 - May 1: no disconnection of gas/electric hardship accounts lacking funds to pay in full; life-threatening loss-of-service cases are protected year-round (PURA).

Winter Payment Plan, Nov 1 - Mar 31: regulated gas/electric utilities cannot shut off service in Dec/Jan/Feb to a household with a child, a senior (62+) or a seriously ill member that cannot pay, if enrolled in the plan (Idaho PUC).
Winter disconnection rule, Dec 1 - Mar 31, for customers using electric or gas as their primary heat source (Illinois Commerce Commission).
Winter disconnection moratorium, Nov 1 - Apr 1, for customers certified eligible for LIHEAP or the Weatherization Assistance Program (Iowa Utilities Commission).
Cold Weather Rule, Nov 1 - Mar 31: no disconnection when temperatures are forecast below 35°F in the next 48 hours; a 12-month payment plan must be offered (Kansas Corporation Commission).

Winter moratorium, standard dates Nov 15 - Mar 15 (temporarily expanded to Oct 27 - Apr 1 for the 2025-26 season): no shutoff of heat-related service for a household that files a financial-hardship form (Mass. Dept. of Public Utilities).

Winter Protection Plan, Nov 1 - Mar 31: shields seniors (65+) from shutoff outright, and low-income customers who pay 7% of estimated annual usage monthly and apply for heating assistance (Michigan PSC).
Cold Weather Rule, Oct 1 - Apr 30: a utility cannot disconnect a customer's primary heat source if the household is below 50% of state median income and keeps an agreed payment plan (Minnesota PUC).

HEFPA winter rule, Nov 1 - Apr 15: utilities must make special contact efforts before terminating heat-related service, plus a mandatory holiday-period moratorium around Christmas/New Year (NY Dept. of Public Service).

PUCO's annually-renewed Winter Reconnect/Special Reconnect Order (current cycle Oct 13, 2025 - Apr 15, 2026) lets any residential customer reconnect or avoid shutoff by paying a capped amount ($175) regardless of the full balance owed; PIPP Plus caps ongoing payments at a share of income for eligible low-income customers.
Winter termination moratorium, Dec 1 - Mar 31, for households at or below 250% of the Federal Poverty Level, under the Responsible Utility Customer Protection Act (Act 201) (Pennsylvania PUC).

summer_disconnect: No shutoff during an NWS Heat Advisory for the customer's county, plus 2 additional days after the advisory ends; providers must also offer a deferred payment plan for bills due during extreme weather (PUC of Texas).

winter_disconnect: Statewide winter disconnection moratorium, Nov 1 - Apr 15, for heat-related residential service; a utility must file and get PSC approval before disconnecting during the moratorium (Wis. Admin. Code PSC 113.0304).
